limits: Previously observed official tests; fixed hyperparameters, no model or policy selection by current test quality.
Selection fits and final train+validation refits differ; validation thresholds cannot calibrate the final models without separate evidence.
Canonical and separately refitted prefit-clean cohorts are distinct from post-hoc filtered rows.
Wine raw scalar MAE/RMSE and genuine probability argmax-bin accuracy differ; probabilities are estimated class values, not established calibrated posteriors.
Wine bin0 (grades0–2) has no source observations; bin4 has five white grade9 rows, including one test row. Grade10 is absent. Extreme-bin performance cannot be generalized from these counts.
CPU setup/profile/quality prediction observations are component measurements, not a GPU model timing study or a monetary frontier.
No native model/hosted calls/funding/clock resets; historical partial local studies and unattempted hosted proposals remain separate.
